question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Reckon
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reckon"** means to calculate, consider, or regard in a specified way. (गणना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **I **reckon** the total cost will be around $200.
 
 
 
• **"Count" **refers to determining the total number of something. (गिनना)
 
 
• **Example: **Can you **count** how many people are in the room?
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'reckon' **is **'count'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Merit **(योग्यता): The quality of being particularly good or worthy.

 
 
• **Example:** His work has great** merit **and deserves recognition.
 
 
 
• **Assess **(मूल्यांकन करना): To evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of.
 
 
• **Example: **We need to **assess** the situation before making a decision.
 
 
 
• **Imagine** (कल्पना करना): To form a mental image or concept of.
 
 
• **Example:** Try to** imagine** a world without pollution.
